description: The constructor of the `impai-persona` test group (impai-persona.json), applied at GameTime 331 with nothing cleared: one CORE construction K-bot (CORCK) of seat 1 at (5000, 760), between its commander and its army, idle. Nothing else of seat 1's is idle then -- in the group's recording at 6b6e332d the lab builds from 53 and the commander from 113, and seat 1 orders nothing from 136 to 712 -- so without this unit its 367 decision orders nothing and the takeover finds no entry.
